title: C.B. Strike
description:
S02 E01 — The Silkworm: Part 1
Cormoran Strike is hired by Leonora Quine to find her husband, the infamous author Owen Quine. Meanwhile, Robin is caught between Strike and Matthew's hopes.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S02 E02 — The Silkworm: Part 2
Delving deeper into the hidden meanings and concealed secrets of Bombyx Mori, Strike and Robin scour all corners of London's literary world to unmask Quine's killer.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S03 E01 — Career of Evil: Part 1
A dismembered leg sent to Strike's office sends both his and Robin's lives into chaos; Strike thinks the limb could belong to a young girl who accused her stepfather of sexual abuse; Strike blames himself for the stepfather eluding justice.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S03 E02 — Career of Evil: Part 2
Strike and Robin's partnership reaches a breaking point as Robin's wedding approaches; they disagree about how to catch a man who abuses children.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S04 E01 — Lethal White: Part 1
Cormoran Strike and Robin Ellacott are at odds following Robin's wedding to Matthew; a visit from a potential client puts a new case on the table.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S04 E02 — Lethal White: Part 2
A startling discovery seems to confirm the story of the strangled child, but the team are forced to leave the scene before they can properly investigate; fearing their witness is in danger, they redouble their efforts to find him.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S04 E03 — Lethal White: Part 3
Robin discovers a startling truth close to home; the government minister's blackmailer becomes the prime suspect in the case, but Robin and Strike believe there was an accomplice.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S04 E04 — Lethal White: Part 4
While Robin struggles with changes in her personal life, she and Strike are able to provide some comfort to a grieving father; the pair interview more players in the case and work with the police, still honing in on the blackmailer's accomplice.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S05 E01 — Troubled Blood
While visiting his family in Cornwall, England, Strike is approached by Anna Phipps, who seeks his help finding her mother who went missing in 1974.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S05 E02 — Troubled Blood
While Strike deals with a difficult family matter, a rogue Robin locates and goes after two potentially dangerous key suspects.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S05 E03 — Troubled Blood
With a narrowing list of unreachable suspects, Strike and Robin utilize their resources to contact notorious serial killer Dennis Creed.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S05 E04 — Troubled Blood
Strike and Robin inch closer to the truth of Margot's disappearance; they may finally bring closure to the past.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S06 E01 — The Ink Black Heart: Part 1
Edie Ledwell, the co-creator of cult TV cartoon "The Ink Black Heart", is being harassed by an online figure, Anomie; she asks Robin to uncover Anomie's true identity.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S06 E02 — The Ink Black Heart: Part 2
Robin, Strike and Barclay all take risks to further the investigation now that they think Anomie probably killed Edie Ledwell; Strike receives an unexpected and unwelcome visitor.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S06 E03 — The Ink Black Heart: Part 3
Robin and Strike make a major breakthrough, having eliminated several suspects; Robin's cover is blown; Strike stays the night at her new flat; Anomie claims another two victims.

title: C.B. Strike
description:
S06 E04 — The Ink Black Heart: Part 4
The agency is the target of a devastating attack; Strike figures out who killed Edie, and having secured proof, Robin puts herself in danger in order to save lives.

description:

When a new grocery store opens near her family's bodega and steals their signature recipe, Robina takes justice into her own hands.

Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E01 — The Long Bright Dark
Former Louisiana State CID partners, Rustin Cohle and Martin Hart, give statements to a pair of investigators about the murder of a prostitute that took place 17 years earlier.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E02 — Seeing Things
Quesada warns Hart and Cohle that they may be replaced by an occult-crimes task force; the pair follows a lead to a rural cathouse and an incinerated church; Hart finds respite away from home.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E03 — The Locked Room
Parishioners identify a scarred man seen with Dora Lange; a sex offender is brought in for interrogation; Maggie sets Cohle up with a friend; Cohle looks over old case files.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E04 — Who Goes There
Hart and Cohle follow a series of leads in an effort to track down their prime suspect.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E05 — The Secret Fate of All Life
Hart and Cohle celebrate a solved case; Papania and Gilbough confront the detectives with new intelligence.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E06 — Haunted Houses
Maggie reveals Cohle's activities in 2002, when his relationship with Hart fractured and he quit the force.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E07 — After You've Gone
Hart and Cohle investigate a string of disappearances that may be tied to the Dora Lange murder and the Tuttle family.

title: True Detective
description:
S01 E08 — Form and Void
Hart and Cohle get a new lead in their 17-year-old case.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E01 — The Western Book of the Dead
The disappearance of a city manager disrupts a lucrative land scheme and ignites a police investigation.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E02 — Night Finds You
Ray and Ani investigate a victim's depraved background; Frank does his own investigation; Paul probes the Vinci police department.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E03 — Maybe Tomorrow
Paul works the prostitute angle; Frank receives the first casualty in a secret war and steps back into a world he left behind.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E04 — Down Will Come
The detail works a pawn shop lead to close in on a suspect in the Caspere case; Frank revisits his past.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E05 — Other Lives
Ray and Frank consider some new life choices; Ani and Paul travel up the coast together to follow a lead.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E06 — Church in Ruins
Frank is desperate to locate a missing woman with information about Caspere; Frank meets with Mexican drug dealers; Ani infiltrates an exclusive inner circle.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E07 — Black Maps and Motel Rooms
Ray, Ani and Paul take precautionary measures to elude detection and untangle a dark mystery; Frank deals with the fallout of his betrayal.

title: True Detective
description:
S02 E08 — Omega Station
Frank, Ray and Ani weigh their options as Caspere's killer and the scope of corruption are both revealed.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E01 — The Great War and Modern Memory
The disappearance of a young Arkansas boy and his sister in 1980 triggers vivid memories and enduring questions for retired detective Wayne Hays, who worked the case 35 years before with partner Roland West.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E02 — Kiss Tomorrow Goodbye
Hays looks back at the aftermath of the 1980 Purcell case, including possible evidence left behind at an outdoor hangout for local kids; as attention focuses on two conspicuous suspects, the parents of the missing children receive a cryptic note.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E03 — The Big Never
Hays recalls his early romance with Amelia, as well as cracks in their relationship that surfaced after they married; 10 years after the Purcell crimes, new evidence emerges, giving Hays a second chance to vindicate himself and the investigation.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E04 — The Hour and the Day
Hays and West see a possible connection between the local church and the Purcell crimes; as the detectives search for one suspect and round up another for interrogation, Woodard is targeted by a vigilante group.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E05 — If You Have Ghosts
Wayne finds himself in a no-win situation as new clues emerge in the Purcell case; Roland wrestles with how to keep evidence secure as lawyers demand a new investigation; Amelia finds her relationship with Wayne imperiled.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E06 — Hunters in the Dark
Wayne and Roland revisit discrepancies in the Purcell case that were hidden or forgotten, and take another look at Tom Purcell and Lucy's cousin, Dan O'Brien; the glitter of Amelia's book release is tarnished by a voice from the past.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E07 — The Final Country
Wayne and Roland track down a man who left the police force in the midst of the Purcell investigation; Amelia visits Lucy Purcell's best friend in hopes of gaining insights into the whereabouts of the mysterious one-eyed man.

title: True Detective
description:
S03 E08 — Now Am Found
Wayne struggles to hold on to his memories, and his grip on reality, as the truth behind the Purcell case is finally revealed.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E01 — Part 1
When researchers suddenly disappear, Liz Danvers orders a search but tempers expectations of finding the men; Navarro tries to convince a skeptical Danvers that the men's disappearance is connected to the murder of local activist Annie Kowtok.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E02 — Part 2
As Danvers and Prior set out to learn more about Tsalal, and find an unlikely location for the physical evidence, Capt. Connelly threatens to move the case to Anchorage; Navarro and Danvers separately find a connection.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E03 — Part 3
While Hank leads the search for Clark, Prior asks Danvers about the murder-suicide case that drove a wedge between her and Navarro; Navarro and Danvers seek out a local hairdresser for insight on Annie.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E04 — Part 4
Julia is struggling with mental health problems again; Navarro takes her to a clinic.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E05 — Part 5
After Navarro rescues Leah from a volatile Silver Sky protest, Danvers gets a warning against pursuing the Tsalal case any further.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description:
S04 E06 — Part 6
As the truth about Tsalal and Annie begins to unfold, Danvers and Navarro each confront the demons from their past.

title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
description: Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother to protect their kingdom and save the world from destruction.
